svg.title: Dataverse business events at Cedar: catalog, publishers and subscribers
svg.desc: Left: who raises events. The planner or a flow calls the action cedar_RequestDispatch, which has a main operation plug-in; the FieldLink status function calls cedar_OnSubcontractorArrived, a custom API with no plug-in that only announces something that already happened. Middle: the catalog that makes events discoverable. Root catalog Cedar Service has two categories. Dispatch events holds catalog assignments for the two custom APIs. Tables holds a catalog assignment for the Work order table, which exposes its bound operations. Right: subscribers react after the operation completed successfully, asynchronously: a cloud flow with the trigger When an action is performed, an asynchronous plug-in step, and webhooks or Azure Service Bus endpoints. Subscribers cannot cancel or change the operation because both custom APIs allow asynchronous steps only.
svg.text: A business event = a message that completed successfully + a catalog entry that lets others find it
Action with a main operation plug-in.
Action, NO plug-in type, no response
Called by the FieldLink status function
when a technician checks in on site.
Trigger: When an action is performed
Registered on the custom API's message,
Service endpoint steps on the same
• Notifications happen only when the operation completed successfully. A refused cedar_RequestDispatch raises nothing.
• Async Only: subscribers cannot cancel, delay or change the operation. A failing subscriber fails only itself.
• Catalog only high-value events. Each event: clear intent, specific, lightweight (IDs and facts, not whole records), not a data export.
Who can see the catalog in Power Automate
Environment Maker sees it. Other roles need Read on Custom API, Process and SDK Message.
In the trigger, Create, Update and Delete of a catalogued table are not listed: use "When a row is added, modified or deleted" for those.
Catalogs and assignments are solution components; set Is Customizable to false before shipping managed.
